title: Beyond Visual CoT: Internalized Visual Thinking for Proactive Video Reasoning
gist: A paper abstract page presenting Internalized Visual Thinking (IVT), a post-training method that teaches multimodal LLMs to predict latent future-frame embeddings during training so they can answer video-reasoning questions directly at inference — matching or beating Visual chain-of-thought while cutting end-to-end latency by more than 5x. The raw record carries no published_date field, though the page text states the paper was published August 2026.

insights.claim: Generating intermediate reasoning images (visual chain-of-thought) imposes substantial inference overhead that makes it particularly ill-suited to proactive video reasoning, where the model must respond before the future is observed.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: The compute cost of image-generating reasoning steps is a real deployment blocker for latency-sensitive video and embodied applications — a headwind for architectures that assume pixel-space reasoning at serve time.
insights.quote: Visual CoT provides an intuitive mechanism for visual foresight but introduces substantial inference overhead, which is particularly problematic for proactive video reasoning.

insights.claim: Explicit pixel-space generation at inference time may be unnecessary for proactive video reasoning, because predictive world modeling can be internalized during training instead.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Directly challenges the premise that world models must render frames to be useful; if it generalizes, serving costs for video-reasoning models fall sharply without new hardware.
insights.quote: Our findings suggest that explicit pixel-space generation at inference time, as used in Visual CoT, may not be necessary for proactive video reasoning.

insights.claim: Internalized Visual Thinking (IVT) is a post-training framework that jointly optimizes textual prediction and next-embedding prediction over unlabeled videos, moving the visual reasoning burden from inference into training.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: A reusable pattern — train on an auxiliary predictive objective, serve a plain text pathway — that other teams can copy to buy accuracy without paying serving latency.
insights.quote: We introduce Internalized Visual Thinking (IVT), a post-training framework that jointly optimizes textual prediction and next-embedding prediction over unlabeled videos.
insights.locator: We ask whether models can learn

insights.claim: IVT trains on unlabeled video, using future-frame latent representations as the supervision signal rather than human annotations.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Removes the annotation bottleneck for video post-training — the scarce input becomes raw video volume, which favors players with large unlabeled video corpora.

insights.claim: By predicting latent representations of future frames alongside the target textual answer, IVT is designed to make the model capture motion, object transitions, interactions, and latent intent.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Names the specific capabilities the objective is meant to induce — the checklist to probe when evaluating whether such models are genuinely anticipatory rather than reactive.
insights.quote: encouraging the model to capture motion, object transitions, interactions, and latent intent

insights.claim: At inference IVT generates the answer directly, without synthesizing or re-encoding future frames, preserving the same efficient pathway as a text-only model.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Means the accuracy gains are essentially free at serve time — an unusually clean cost/quality tradeoff for anyone budgeting inference capacity.
insights.quote: At inference, IVT generates the answer directly without synthesizing or re-encoding future frames.

insights.claim: IVT reports comparable or better performance than Visual CoT while reducing end-to-end latency by more than 5x.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: A greater-than-5x latency cut at equal quality is the kind of margin that changes what video reasoning can be deployed on-device or in real time.
insights.quote: Compared with Visual CoT, IVT achieves comparable or better performance and reduces end-to-end latency by more than 5×.

insights.claim: IVT beat text-only post-training in all six evaluation settings tested, a clean sweep rather than a mixed result — though the abstract names neither the benchmarks nor the base model.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Consistency across six settings is stronger evidence than a single headline score, but the missing benchmark and base-model names mean the claim cannot yet be independently sized.
insights.quote: IVT improves over text-only post-training across all six evaluation settings while retaining the same efficient inference pathway.

insights.claim: An ICLR paper listed alongside this work argues that despite CoT prompting being a de-facto standard for eliciting reasoning from LLMs, the driving forces behind its success remain largely unclear.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: The industry standard reasoning technique is still poorly understood mechanistically — a reason to discount confident claims that any particular CoT recipe is optimal.

insights.claim: A related ACL paper finds that training vision language models on short-answer datasets with minimal rationales leads to poor generalization on reasoning tasks needing detailed explanations, motivating a two-stage recipe.
insights.speaker: Apple ML Research
insights.so_what: Data composition, not just scale, gates reasoning quality in VLMs — annotation strategy is a differentiator worth diligence on.
